title: Embercore Path

The Embercore Path is recommended for Levels 40 to 90. It is the eighth dungeon in the usual sequence, proceeding from Mutanous Malaise. It is accessible from The Room of Creation and via The Embercore Portal.

According to Loremaster Vraile, "The Embercore Path is a very interesting dungeon, and one that has become a firestorm of activity. You see, The Embercore Path used to be a wonderful candy factory run by a man named Wally Wanka. Every year he would announce new amazing candy flavors that had the men, women and children PVPing for a taste. Wanka's candies became so popular that he had to shut down his factory to the public because they kept farming for phat treats. It wasn't long after Wanka closed the factory to the public that something terrible happened: monsters took over the candy factory! No one is sure exactly when it happened, but the word is that a dungeon overlord named Abaddon is now the boss of The Embercore Path."


DUNGEON DETAILS

The Embercore Portal

Lava Pools Layout.

Contains:

  • Portal to Level 5 of The Mutanous Malaise
  • Portal to Level 1 of The Embercore Path
  • NPC: Ol' Chuck Pail
  • NPC: Wally Wanka

Level 1

Crypt Layout. Contains Arctic Fellknights, Icy Phantoms, Volcanic Fade Lichlords, Fire Banshees, and Chaotic Fade Generals. May also contain statues that, when hit, create a mob of unfriendly Abba Labbas.

Storeroom 1A and The Break Room are located off Level 1.

Storeroom 1A

Contains Searing Geists, Embercore Felknights, Embercore Thornlashes, Blood Mystics, Orok Recruits, and also Abba Labbas, Candy Golems, and the Hero Abbazabbadon, who drop lots of candy for Wally Wanka's quests. There are also 12 Candy Fabricator machines which can be destroyed to fulfill a quest.

Here you will also find the NPC Mopicles the Janiator who will give quests in the Storeroom 1A Cellar.

Storeroom 1A Cellar

A small room with four corner rooms and a center section behind closed gates. Contains Orok Recruits, Blood Orok Mystics, Embercore Thornlashes, and Searing Geists. In two of the corner rooms are Sensory Deprivation Chambers. When opened they release Abaddon's Ciphers, Searing Geist Champions. After both the Champions are killed the gates open and in the center section is an extra large Sensory Deprivation Chamber containing the Abaddon's Cipher Hero.

The Break Room

This room is accessed through the Most Excellent Magic Phone Booth, which has been spotted on the first four levels of the Embercore Path. It contains a Champion and supporters, all of whom release gobs and gobs of candy when killed, for Wally Wanka's quests.

Level 2

Crypt Layout. Contains Arctic Fellknights, Icy Phantoms, Volcanic Fade Lichlords, Frigidly Cruel Maulers, and Chaotic Fade Generals. Somewhere on Level 2 is the Candy Machine which drops lots of candy when destroyed.

Level 3

Crypt Layout. Contains Ice creatures: Frigidly Cruel Mauler, Icy Phantom, Arctic Felknight, Frothing Nightraythe. Fire creatures: Ember Rachnid, Volcanic Fade Lich Lord, and also Chaos Fade General.

Find the Abba Labba statue and you will encounter a number of Abba Labbas who will drop lots of candy when killed.

NPC's: KC Sally has been encountered on this level.

Storeroom 3A

This room is located off of Embercore Level 3. It is a Dungeon Layout. Contains Blood Mystic, Searing Geist, Embercore Felknight. The Champion Abbadabbadoodon is located here.

The NPC Concerned Abba Labba will open the door to the Storeroom 3A cellar.

Storeroom 3A Cellar

This room contains the Watcher of the Candies, a giant floating candy with great Knockback powers. Killing it releases piles of candy. This room also contains eight Candy Fabricator Machines.

Level 4

Crypt Layout. Ice monsters: Icy Phantoms, Arctic Felknights, Frothing Nightraythes, Frigidly Cruel Mauler. Fire monsters: Ember Rachnids, Volcanic Fade Lich Lords. Also: Chaos Generals. Storeroom 4A is located off of Level 4.

Storeroom 4A

Catacombs Layout. Contains: Oroks: Orok Warrior, Blood Mystic. Fire Monsters: Embercore Angel, Embercore Felknight. Also contains Abba Labba, Candy Golem and Abbracadabradonna.

NPC: Mopicles the Janiator appears again, and gives quests for Storeroom 4A Cellar.

Storeroom 4A Cellar

Contains Orok Warrior, Blood Mystic, Orok Juggernaut. In the center is a large Sensory Deprivation Chamber containing the Abaddon's Cipher Hero which is an Blood Mystic. Killing it opens the gates to the side chambers which have 3 more chambers and three more Cipher Champions.

Level 5

Lava Pools Layout. Contains Orok Warrior, Fledgling Hunter, Blood Mystic, Embercore Felknight, Embercore Prophetess. Level 5 contains the entrance to Storeroom 5A and the Most Excellent Magic Phone Booth which leads to The Break Room.


Storeroom 5A

Catacombs Layout. Contains Orok Cave Peon, Earth Sprite, Deviant Hurler and Mutant Ranged Wasp. andAbadunkadunkadonna. The NPC Concerned Abba Labba gives a quest in the Cellar and opens the gate.

Storeroom 5A Cellar

Contains the Watcher of the Candies and the Keeper of the Candies.

The Break Room

A small room which contains Embercore Prophetess, Embercore Felknight and an Orok Mystic Champion. They all drop lots of candy.

Level 6

Lava Pools Layout. Contains Orok Recruit, Fledgling Hunter, Blood Mystic, Embercore Felknight, Embercore Angel, Embercore Prophetess. Striking the Abba Labba Statue will generate a horde of Abba Labbas.

Level 7

Lava Pools Layout. Contains Orok Recruit, Blood Mystic, Embercore Felknight, Embercore Angel, Embercore Prophetess. Storeroom 7A, Storeroom 7B and Cleft of the Searing Knight are located off Level 7.

Storeroom 7A

Catacombs Layout. Contains Orok Cave Peon, Earth Sprite, Deviant Hurler and Mutant Ranged Wasp. Also contains Candy Fabricator Machines, Abba Labbas, a Candy Golem and the Champion Abbadumdadumdumdon who drop lots of candy. Here you will also find the NPC Mopicles the Janiator who will give quests in the Storeroom 7A Cellar.

Storeroom 7A Cellar

There are 8 side rooms, of which 6 contain Abaddon's Ciphers in the form of Mutant Melee Wasps. Destroying these 6 will open the central chamber which contains a bigger Cipher Hero, and the treasure chamber.

Storeroom 7B

Catacombs Layout. Contains Orok Cave Peon, Earth Sprite, Deviant Hurler and Mutant Ranged Wasp. Also contains Candy Fabricator Machines, Abba Labbas, a Candy Golem and the Champion Abbadupercalifragilisticexpialdonna who drop lots of candy. The NPC Concerned Abba Labba gives a quest in the Cellar and opens the gate.

Storeroom 7B Cellar

Contains the Watcher of the Candies, the Keeper of the Candies and the Taker of the Candies.

Cleft of the Searing Knight

Abbadon, Boss of The Embercore Path

Here you will find Abaddon's Guards, two melee fighters and one mage/healer, and the boss Abaddon himself.

A one-way portal here leads to Shadow's Embrace.

For tips on fighting Abaddon, see the Abaddon Boss Guide.
